mapper.select: SELECT periodid, branchid, mode, title, startdate, enddate FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_period WHERE useyn = 'Y' AND #{plandate} BETWEEN startdate AND enddate AND branchid IN ('ALL', #{branchid}) ORDER BY (branchid = 'ALL') ASC, periodid DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT mode, class, code, label, shortlabel, timetext FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_slot WHERE mode = #{mode} ORDER BY class ASC
SELECT mode, class, code, label, shortlabel, timetext FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_slot ORDER BY mode DESC, class ASC

SELECT periodid, branchid, mode, title, startdate, enddate FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_period WHERE useyn = 'Y' AND startdate > #{plandate} AND branchid IN ('ALL', #{branchid}) ORDER BY startdate ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) totcnt FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_period WHERE branchid = #{branchid}

SELECT periodid, branchid, mode, title, startdate, enddate, useyn, memo, reguserid, DATE_FORMAT(regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate, DATE_FORMAT(upddate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') upddate FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_period WHERE branchid = #{branchid} ORDER BY startdate DESC, periodid DESC
LIMIT ${length} OFFSET ${start}
SELECT periodid, branchid, mode, title, startdate, enddate, useyn, memo FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_period WHERE periodid = ${periodid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.timetable_period ( branchid, mode, title, startdate, enddate, useyn, memo, reguserid, regdate ) VALUES ( #{branchid}, #{mode}, #{title}, #{startdate}, #{enddate}, #{useyn}, #{memo}, #{reguserid}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ttokssaemdb.timetable_period SET title = #{title}, startdate = #{startdate}, enddate = #{enddate}, useyn = #{useyn}, memo = #{memo}, upddate = now() WHERE periodid = ${periodid} AND branchid = #{branchid}
